subject: Voice message: quotation request from Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
body:
Hello,

I am on the road today, so I recorded our quotation request as a voice message. Please listen to the attached recording (voice-message.mp3). It has all details of the shipment.

Please reply by mail with your all-in price in EUR.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
